scope: paragraph and ABBA artifacts only; registry/provenance audit
decision: Most named paragraph/ABBA methods are search or repair variants over the same complete-clause bank/composition operator. The genuinely distinct evidence is (1) independently authored intact-unit ABBA seam search, (2) complete-word residual targeting, and (3) the exact but readability-poor grammar-abba reader candidates. None has reader certification.

genuinely_distinct.operator: four independently authored intact prose units with live ABBA seam
genuinely_distinct.changed_dimension: provenance/authoring boundary; intact sentence units rather than a generated clause bank
genuinely_distinct.finding: distinct construction, but no closure; supported_depth 0 and first mismatch at offset 0

renamed_or_compositional_shortcuts.reason: same A1/B1/B2/A2 (or nested clause-pair) composition with a live character equation; changing topology/trie/index names does not change lexical-role, dependency, or repair state
residual-directed authoring is a bounded prefix-selection repair over the same four-unit composition; two-character versus one-character targeting is parameterization, not a new construction operator
all are clause-bank/trie orderings or residual-conditioned joins; registry's changed-dimension rule rejects larger/reordered search as novelty

rendered_examples_and_exact_audits.text: At dawn, the cartographer left the harbor to chart a quiet inlet. Meanwhile, the mechanic tightened a loose wheel beside the workshop. Later, the apprentice mended a frayed strap behind the tool shed. By dusk, the surveyor returned from the pier after mapping a sheltered bay.
After rain, the old harbor keeper opened the gate. The quiet students copied the river map. The patient baker shared warm bread with neighbors. At sunset, the harbor keeper closed the gate.
Nora, I saw evil. Noel, I saw war. Raw was I, Leon. Live was I, Aron.
provenance_flags: exact but highly constrained/unnatural phrase morphology

shortcut_flags: No exact result should be counted as readable evidence.
The 2026-10-01/02 complete-word gates are useful diagnostics but remain composition over fixed authored frames; they do not supply a new discourse or dependency operator.
The 2026-10-02 reader packet is prepared, not rated; its two exact candidates inherit the grammar-abba source and therefore are not independent generator evidence.

next_untried_construction_boundary.name: discourse-linked sentence-opening/closing frame lattice
next_untried_construction_boundary.boundary: Author each A/B unit as a two-sentence micro-scene with an explicit topic state and a complete ordinary opening word. Solve only the seam between the prior unit's final content word and the next unit's opening word; do not concatenate or reverse-render a prebuilt clause bank. A/B units must introduce distinct events, while B2 and A2 inherit discourse referents (not lexical text) from B1/A1.
next_untried_construction_boundary.why_readability_may_improve: Topic continuity and referent tracking constrain paraphrase choices, while sentence-level complete-word seams avoid the fragmentary residuals seen in character-prefix targeting.
admission_tests: 3+ words per sentence and ordinary punctuation
